name: Chiruvilwadi Kashayam

sections.introduction: Chiruvilwadi Kashayam is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of effective herbs. This medicine is known to treat the problems related to digestive system.
sections.ingredients:
Chirabilwa – Holoptelea integrifolia 
 Vahni – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Punarnava – Boerhaavia diffusa 
 Nagara – Zingiber officinalis 
 Kana – Piper longum 
 Saindhava – Rock salt 
 Abhaya – Terminalia chebula 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take all the ingredients and powder them. 
 Know put this mixture into a pot and add the water. 
 Warm the mixture till the water is reduced to its one fourth level. 
 Filter the solution and your decoction is prepared.
sections.dose: 5 to 10 ml, empty stomach, one to two times a day, before meals.
sections.indications:
Plies 
 Abdominal lumps 
 Burning sensations 
 Bloating 
 Digestion power 
 Constipation 
 Fistula
sections.contraindications:
Worsens gastritis in high doses. 
 Take under medical prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Chiruvilwadi Kashayam 
 Reference – Sahasrayoga, Kashaya Prakarana. 
 Introduction 
 Chiruvilwadi Kashayam is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from mixture of effective herbs. This medicine is known to treat the problems related to digestive system. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Chirabilwa – Holoptelea integrifolia 
 Vahni – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Punarnava – Boerhaavia diffusa 
 Nagara – Zingiber officinalis 
 Kana – Piper longum 
 Saindhava – Rock salt 
 Abhaya – Terminalia chebula 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients and powder them. 
 Know put this mixture into a pot and add the water. 
 Warm the mixture till the water is reduced to its one fourth level. 
 Filter the solution and your decoction is prepared. 
 
 Dose 
 5 to 10 ml, empty stomach, one to two times a day, before meals. 
 Indications 
 
 Plies 
 Abdominal lumps 
 Burning sensations 
 Bloating 
 Digestion power 
 Constipation 
 Fistula 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Worsens gastritis in high doses. 
 Take under medical prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
